name: Bluesky (AT Protocol)

counting.notes: DUAL CEILING: Must satisfy <=300 grapheme clusters (Intl.Segmenter) AND <=3,000 UTF-8 bytes. Rich text facets (links/mentions/tags) require exact 0-indexed UTF-8 byteStart/byteEnd offsets (NOT JS UTF-16 .length).

hashtags.excessBehavior: Must be serialized as app.bsky.richtext.facet#tag with UTF-8 byte indices.
hashtags.notes: Keep to 1-3 tags within the 300-grapheme budget.

links.recommendedStrategy: External links are welcomed on Bluesky with zero algorithmic link penalty; include an external embed card with <=1MB thumbnail.
links.notes: Open protocol feeds do not suppress outbound links; must encode URLs as app.bsky.richtext.facet#link.

oauth.gotcha: DECIMAL BYTE CAP: app.bsky.embed.images enforces 2,000,000 decimal bytes (NOT 2 MiB = 2,097,152 bytes) and strictly 4 images (up to 10 images requires app.bsky.embed.gallery); OS-reported '2.0 MB' images fail PDS upload. Link card thumbnails stay at 1,000,000 bytes. Cannot mix images + video. Video upload (10-min / 300 MB as of Aug 2026) requires verified email and faces daily ceiling (~25 videos / 10 GB). Numeric-only hashtags (#2026) do not linkify. Supported video formats: MP4 (H.264 recommended), MOV, WebM, MPEG.

sources: AT Protocol Lexicons (app.bsky.feed.post maxGraphemes:300 / maxLength:3000, app.bsky.embed.images maxSize:2000000 / 10-image carousel, app.bsky.embed.video 10-min Aug 2026 / 300MB)
Bluesky Moderation: Composable labeler ecosystem (Ozone/Osprey) — subscribe to third-party labelers for content warnings
